name: Menhera Mate
source:
You get to know some girls in the school and have a relationship with her.
These girls are all mentally ill.
This work is on the theme of "pure love."

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ043552.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你会在学校结识数名女孩，并与其中一人发展恋爱关系。
这些女孩都患有精神疾病。
本作以“纯爱”为主题。

[译自 [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ043552.html]DLsite English[/url]]
